# hiok_event_subscription (Resource)

Filters a stream and delivers matching events to a handler.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `namespace_id` (String)
- `stream` (String) Stream to subscribe to.

### Optional

- `event_format` (String)
- `handler_type` (String) webhook, servicebus_queue, pulse_stream.
- `included_event_types` (List of String) Only these event types are delivered.
- `max_delivery_attempts` (Number)
- `subject_begins_with` (String)
- `target_topic` (String) Target topic for forwarding handlers.
- `webhook_url` (String) Target URL when handler_type is webhook.

### Read-Only

- `dead_lettered` (Number) Events dead-lettered.
- `delivered` (Number) Events delivered.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
